blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion models have become strong priors for solving inverse problems. However, nonlinear inverse problems such as phase retrieval remain challenging when multiple measurement-consistent solutions are distinguishable only by the prior; we call such measurements ambiguous. Existing diffusion-based samplers rely on local approximations during reconstruction. For an ambiguous measurement, these approximations can allow measurement guidance to favor a measurement-consistent mode that is close to a prior-supported mode but is itself not supported by the prior. Evaluation often masks this type of failure by reporting the best-of-$k$ runs, where the best is selected by comparison to the ground truth. We introduce Prior-Consistent DAPS (PC-DAPS), a variant of Decoupled Annealing Posterior Sampling (DAPS) designed to address this failure case by maintaining multiple candidate solutions within a single sampling run. As annealing noise decreases, PC-DAPS prunes and replaces weaker candidates according to their prior consistency, without any ground-truth access. PC-DAPS reduces the incidence of prior-inconsistent samples and improves sample quality on nonlinear inverse problems while preserving sample quality and diversity on linear inverse problems.
blocks.zh: 扩散模式已成为解决反向问题的强项。 然而,当多个符合测量方法的解决方案只能与先前的方法区分时,诸如相位检索等非线性反向问题仍然具有挑战性;我们称这些测量方法模糊不清。 现有的基于传播的采样机在重建过程中依赖于当地近似值. 对于一个模棱两可的测量,这些近似值可以允许测量指导倾向于一种接近于先前支持的模式但本身不受先前支持的测量一致模式. 评价往往通过报告最优的美元运行情况来掩盖这种失败,与地面真相相比,最佳的运行情况是经过挑选的。 我们提出 " 预先一致的DAPS " (PC-DAPS),这是脱钩的Annaling Posessorior Sampling(DAPS)的一个变体,旨在通过在一次抽样中维持多种候选解决方案来解决这一故障。 随着反响的噪音减少,PC-DAPS按其先前的一致性进行挤压和替换较弱的候选人,而没有任何地面真实访问. PC-DAPS可以减少先前不一致的样本的发生,提高非线性反向问题的样本质量,同时在线性反向问题上保持样本质量和多样性.

blocks.en: Inverse problems arise across science and engineering whenever an unknown signal must be recovered from indirect measurements, including image restoration ( Bertero et al., 2021 ) , medical imaging ( Song et al., 2022 ) , and astronomical imaging ( Event Horizon Telescope Collaboration, 2019 ) . Given an observed measurement y y generated through a known but potentially noisy measurement process, the goal of the inverse problem is to recover the original signal x x . For underdetermined problems, in which many different signals x x may give rise to the same measurement y y , Bayesian imaging defines the posterior distribution as p ⁡ ( x ∣ y ) ∝ p ⁡ ( y ∣ x ) ​ p ​ ( x ) p(x\mid y)\propto p(y\mid x)p(x) , where the likelihood p ⁡ ( y ∣ x ) p(y\mid x) captures measurement consistency of a candidate image x x and the prior p ⁡ ( x ) p(x) captures which candidate reconstructions are plausible natural signals. The goal of posterior sampling is thus to generate candidate reconstructions that are simultaneously consistent with the measurement and the prior.

blocks.en: In Fourier phase retrieval, for example, multiple images can produce identical Fourier magnitude measurements ( Fienup, 1982 ) . These measurement-equivalent solutions therefore have the same likelihood, but can have very different posterior probabilities depending on their consistency with the image prior. In particular, we observe that existing phase-retrieval solvers applied to face images sometimes return a rotated or color-inverted face that is consistent with the measurement but implausible under a natural-image prior concentrated on upright faces. The challenge is therefore not simply to find measurement-consistent reconstructions, but to sample the measurement-consistent solutions supported by the prior.
blocks.zh: 例如,在Fourier相位检索中,多个图像可以产生相同的Fourier量度测量(Fienup,1982 ). 因此,这些测量等同的解决方案具有同样的可能性,但根据其与前作图像的一致性,其后作概率可能大不相同. 特别是,我们观察到,用于面部图像的现有相位检索解析器有时会返回一个旋转或色向倒置的面孔,这个面孔与测量一致,但在先集中在直立面的自然图像下却不可信. 因此,挑战不仅仅是寻找符合计量要求的重建,而是对先前支持的符合计量要求的解决方案进行抽样。

blocks.en: Diffusion models provide strong image priors for posterior sampling ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021 ) . At each noise level, a diffusion model implicitly defines a denoiser that maps a noisy sample x t x_{t} to an estimate of the corresponding clean image; this diffusion denoiser can be used to incorporate the prior p ⁡ ( x ) p(x) during posterior sampling. Diffusion-based inverse solvers apply this prior information along a sampling trajectory , i.e., the sequence of intermediate states that evolves from a noisy sample toward a reconstruction. Existing methods primarily either tilt the unconditional reverse diffusion process using an approximate likelihood gradient ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Chung et al., 2023 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Boys et al., 2024 ) or alternate prior and measurement updates across noise levels ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Xu and Chi, 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Ahmed and Makin, 2026 ) . In these methods, the prior information available at each noise level is represented through a local denoising approximation centered on a single clean-image estimate, rather than explicitly maintaining multiple competing prior modes at intermediate timesteps.
blocks.zh: 扩散模型为后期取样提供了强大的图像前传(Ho等人,2020年;Song等人,2021年). 在每一个噪声级别上,一个扩散模型隐含地定义了将一个吵闹的样本x t x_{t}映射到相应的清洁图像的估计数的凹凸层;这种扩散凹凸层可用于在后期取样中包含先前的p ⁡ (x) p (x). 基于扩散的反向解析器沿着一个采样轨迹应用这个先前的信息,即中间状态的序列从一个吵闹的样本向重建发展. 现有方法主要采用大致概率梯度使无条件反向扩散过程倾斜(Zhang等人,2025年;Chung等人,2023年;Song等人,2023年;Boys等人,2024年),或者在噪声水平上交替更新和测量更新(Wu等人,2024年;Xu和Chi,2024年;Chen等人,2026年;Ahmed和Makin,2026年)。 在这些方法中,每个噪声级别上可获得的先前信息都通过以单一清洁图像估计为核心的局部去诺近似表示,而不是在中间时段明确保持多个相互竞争的先前模式.

blocks.en: When the measurement is ambiguous, as in the case of phase retrieval and other underdetermined inverse problems, following a sampling trajectory can lead to premature mode selection . At high noise levels, multiple prior modes may remain plausible, but the trajectory can only move towards one of them. Once a trajectory selects a particular prior mode, subsequent refinement primarily improves measurement consistency in the local neighborhood of that mode rather than considering more distant alternatives. This becomes problematic when (i) the selected prior mode is not consistent with the measurement, and (ii) its nearest measurement-consistent mode is not supported by the prior. Trajectory-based samplers can prematurely commit to this pair of modes, ultimately resulting in hallucinatory sampled reconstructions that are not supported by the true posterior or even the true prior. Best-of- k k evaluation partially masks this issue by generating multiple independent reconstructions and selecting the one closest to the ground truth ( Chung et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . However, this selection uses information unavailable at test time and does not ensure that the produced samples are prior-consistent. Particle-based approaches maintain multiple candidates at intermediate timesteps ( Cardoso et al., 2024 ; Dou and Song, 2024 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) , but have primarily focused on linear inverse problems and particle diversity rather than prior-consistent sampling.
blocks.zh: 当测量模棱两可时,如相位检索和其他不确定的反向问题,采用取样轨迹可能导致过早选择模式。 在高噪声水平下,多种前期模式可能仍然可行,但轨迹只能朝其中的一种方向移动. 一旦一个轨迹选择了特定的前一种模式,随后的改进主要会提高该模式当地周边的测量一致性,而不是考虑更远的替代品. 如果(一) 选定的前一种模式与测量不一致,(二) 其最近的测量-一致模式不为前一种模式所支持,就会产生问题。 基于轨迹的采样者可以过早地致力于这对模式,最终导致产生幻觉的采样重建,这些重建得不到真实的后人甚至真实的前人的支持. blocks.en: To address this issue, we introduce Prior-Consistent DAPS (PC-DAPS), which moves sample selection inside the sampler and removes the need for ground-truth-based best-of- k k evaluation. PC-DAPS maintains a bag of K K particles annealed under the same measurement, and models the denoiser posterior p ⁡ ( x 0 ∣ x t ) p(x_{0}\mid x_{t}) with a K K -component Gaussian mixture rather than a unimodal estimate. Early in sampling, multiple candidates are kept while the noise level is high and the prior is still weakly informative. As the noise decreases during annealing, particles with low prior consistency are pruned and replaced by surviving candidates that are more prior-consistent. PC-DAPS thus delays mode selection until the prior becomes more informative, performing within a single sampling run (and without ground-truth access) what best-of- k k does only after k k independent sampling runs.

PC-DAPS在同样的测量下维持一个袋装有K K 颗粒的Aneaced,模型为denoiser后置p ⁡ (x 0 ∣ x t) p(x _{0}\ mid x_{t}),其中含有K K - 组件高斯亚混合物,而不是单式估计. 早期采样时,多位考生被保留,同时噪声水平较高,之前的考生信息仍然薄弱. 随着震动时噪声减少,先前一致性较低的颗粒被挤压,代之以存活的更前向一致性的候选者. 因此,PC-DAPS将模式选择延迟到前一个模式变得更为信息化,在一次抽样运行中进行(并且没有地面真实访问),只有在kk独立抽样运行后才进行最佳kk模式选择。

blocks.en: We evaluate PC-DAPS on FFHQ ( Karras et al., 2019 ) and ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) across three nonlinear and seven linear tasks, including the eight tasks reported in DAPS ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) as well as high-pass filtering ( Thaker et al., 2025 ) and 16 × \times super-resolution. We report PSNR, SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) under both single-sample and best-of- k k evaluation. We additionally compare the rate of prior-inconsistent hallucinations against independent DAPS runs. PC-DAPS reduces the incidence of prior-inconsistent samples and improves performance on ambiguous nonlinear problems while maintaining image quality and diversity on linear inverse problems. Our contributions are as follows: • We propose PC-DAPS, which maintains a bag of particles, models the denoiser posterior with a Gaussian mixture, and performs prior-based pruning without access to ground truth. • We evaluate PC-DAPS across seven linear and three nonlinear inverse problems on FFHQ and ImageNet, showing fewer prior-inconsistent reconstructions and improved nonlinear reconstruction quality while preserving performance on linear tasks.

blocks.en: Split and annealed posterior sampling. In contrast, variable-splitting methods alternate between prior-only and measurement-only steps. Among methods using a diffusion model for the prior step, PnP-DM ( Wu et al., 2024 ) uses a split Gibbs sampler for the likelihood, while DPnP ( Xu and Chi, 2024 ) uses Metropolis-Hastings and DiffPIR ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) utilizes a proximal step. Finally, DAPS ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) utilizes a repeated denoising-renoising scheme ( Section 3.2 ). RePS ( Ahmed and Makin, 2026 ) adds restarts to that schedule, and DAPS++ ( Chen et al., 2026 ) reports that the DAPS reconstruction is largely driven by measurement consistency. We therefore design PC-DAPS as a modification of DAPS that retains its variable-splitting structure but introduces prior-based selection to discriminate between measurement-consistent reconstructions.

blocks.en: Particle-based posterior sampling. Another group of approaches maintains many particles throughout sampling, and uses sequential Monte Carlo to propagate, reweight, and resample particles to progressively improve measurement consistency ( Cardoso et al., 2024 ; Janati et al., 2025 ) . FPS-SMC ( Dou and Song, 2024 ) casts the reverse sampling process as a state-space model and applies a particle filter. TDS ( Wu et al., 2023 ) uses twisting functions to obtain asymptotic exactness for general measurement models. While particle-based methods are typically concerned with the fidelity of the ensemble in the limit of many particles, we are concerned instead with the probability that a single returned reconstruction is prior-inconsistent, and use particles for the purpose of exploring the posterior landscape.
blocks.zh: 以颗粒为基础的后取样。 另一组方法在整个取样过程中维持许多颗粒,并使用相继的蒙特卡洛传播、重新加权和重新取样颗粒以逐步提高测量一致性(Cardoso等人,2024年;Janati等人,2025年)。 TDS(Wu等人,2023年)使用扭矩函数来获得一般测量模型的不对称精确度. 虽然以粒子为基础的方法通常关注许多粒子极限中的共聚物的忠诚性,但我们却关注单个返回的重建是事先不一致的概率,并使用粒子来探索后期景观.

blocks.en: Diagnosing hallucination and prior misfit. Hallucination has been studied as a property of reconstruction algorithms in inverse problems since before diffusion priors were adopted ( Bhadra et al., 2021 ) , and refers to any reconstruction that is inconsistent with either the measurement or the prior. Recent work has sought to quantify hallucination specifically for diffusion-based solvers ( Jin et al., 2026 ) . At the level of the model rather than the individual sample, DiME ( Wang and Bouman, 2026 ) estimates the evidence of a diffusion prior by integrating over the time-marginals of a posterior sampler, and can be run alongside DAPS to detect prior misfit. Closest to our framing, Burns and Fridovich-Keil (2026) adopt a finite-sample perspective on reverse diffusion dynamics and show that widely used guidance approximations misestimate posterior spread at intermediate noise levels. This misestimation produces both prior modes absent from the true posterior and likelihood (measurement-consistent) modes unsupported by the prior, which is the specific failure that our PC-DAPS method aims to address. Benchmarks whose posteriors are analytically tractable provide a complementary check on the uncertainty a solver reports ( Crafts and Villa, 2025 ; Zach et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) . All of these existing hallucination diagnostics are applied after sampling; PC-DAPS utilizes prior support during sampling to decide which reconstructions survive, thereby reducing the incidence of prior-inconsistent hallucinations.
blocks.zh: 诊断幻觉和之前的不适应. 自采用扩散前题(Bhadra等人,2021年)以来,迷幻作为重建算法在反向问题中的一种属性研究,并指任何与测量或前题不一致的重建. 近期的工作力求对幻觉进行量化,专门用于扩散式解析器(Jin等人,2026年)。 在模型层面而不是单个样本层面,DiME(Wang and Bouman,2026年)通过在后期采样器的时边结合来估算之前扩散的证据,并可以和DAPS一起运行,以检测之前的错配. Burns和Fridovich-Keil(2026年)对反向扩散动力学采取有限抽样观点, 这种错误估计既产生真实后方所没有的先前模式,也产生前方所不支持的可能性(度量-一致性)模式,这是我们PC-DAPS方法旨在解决的具体失败. 事后可进行分析的基准是对解决者报告的不确定性的补充检查(Crafts and Villa,2025;Zach等人,2026;Zheng等人,2025)。 所有这些现有的幻觉诊断都是在取样后应用的;PC-DAPS在取样时利用事先的支持来决定哪些重建能够存活下来,从而降低先前不一致的幻觉的发生率.

blocks.en: For example, in Fourier phase retrieval, two images which are identical up to rotation, translation, and/or color channel sign appear visually quite distinct but produce identical Fourier magnitude measurements ( Fienup, 1982 ) . On structured face images, a solver can return a 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} -rotated or color-inverted (e.g., blue) face that fits the observed Fourier measurement despite being inconsistent with a prior distribution supported only on the set of upright faces. We refer to such reconstructions as prior-inconsistent . Prior-inconsistent reconstructions commonly appear across classical phase-retrieval methods ( Fienup, 1982 ) , deep-learning approaches ( Metzler et al., 2018 ; Işil and Oktem, 2025 ) , and diffusion-based inverse-problem solvers ( Xu and Chi, 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Our goal is to reduce the frequency of prior-inconsistent solutions while retaining quality and diversity of measurement- and prior-consistent samples.

blocks.en: 3.2 Decoupled Annealing Posterior Sampling (DAPS)
blocks.zh: 3.2 脱钩的Annaling前身取样

blocks.en: To develop a sampler which produces fewer prior-inconsistent samples, we build on existing approaches by (i) identifying the root causes that produce the inconsistent samples and (ii) making adjustments to reduce the incidence of these samples. Specifically, we build on DAPS ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , a diffusion-based variable-splitting approach which repeatedly (i) denoises to a clean image via the reverse diffusion process, (ii) improves the clean image’s likelihood consistency via MCMC (e.g., Langevin dynamics ( Roberts and Tweedie, 1996 ) ), and (iii) renoises the MCMC output via the forward diffusion process. By adding less noise back than was originally present, DAPS aims to iteratively denoise towards a measurement-consistent clean sample.

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: To address the presence of prior-inconsistent samples, a first approach might be to produce multiple samples via DAPS and discard any which are prior-inconsistent. There are two main shortcomings of this approach: (i) the effective sample size of this sampling method is suboptimal, as substantial computational resources are used to produce samples that are then thrown out, and (ii) it is unclear how to select which samples to discard without having access to the ground truth signal or posterior.
blocks.zh: 为了解决存在先前不一致的样品的问题,第一种办法是通过DAPS生产多个样品,并丢弃任何先前不一致的样品。 这种方法有两个主要缺点: (一)这种采样方法的有效样本尺寸不理想,因为大量计算资源被用来生产样品,然后被抛出; (二)在无法获取地面真象信号或后遗症的情况下,不清楚如何选择哪些样品丢弃.

blocks.en: To address these issues, we introduce PC-DAPS, a procedure for correcting prematurely committed particles during the sampling process without requiring access to the ground truth image or to any pre-trained prior-inconsistency classifier. PC-DAPS maintains a bag of K K particles, each of which is denoised using the same annealing schedule and pretrained denoiser, but uses different initializations and random noise in its Langevin and renoising updates. If no additional modifications are made to DAPS, the K K particles will denoise independently, and can be partitioned into (nonempty) sets of “bad” prematurely committed particles and “good” particles that are posterior-consistent. The core idea of PC-DAPS is to improve DAPS’s existing renoising strategy by identifying prematurely committed particles during sampling and moving them to more promising modes discovered by other particles in the bag. Additionally, PC-DAPS utilizes the particles to refine additional design decisions made by DAPS, such as by replacing the unimodal Gaussian approximation to the denoising distribution with an adaptive Gaussian mixture model (GMM) approximation. A toy example illustrating the benefit of this Gaussian mixture approximation is shown in Section A.3 .
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,我们采用了PC-DAPS这一程序,在取样过程中纠正过早承诺的颗粒,而不需要接触地面真实图像或任何事先经过训练的前不一致分类器。 PC-DAPS维持着一袋K K粒子,每袋都使用相同的反射时间表和预先训练的脱氧核糖核酸(denoiser),但在它的Langevin和重新命名更新中使用了不同的初始化和随机噪声. 如果对DAPS不作进一步修改,K粒子将独立剥离,并可被分割成(非空的)几组“不良”过早承诺的粒子和“良好”粒子,这些粒子在后期具有一致性。 PC-DAPS的核心思想是改进DAPS现有的重新命名策略,方法是在取样时识别过早承诺的颗粒,并将它们转移到袋中其他颗粒发现的更有希望的模式. 此外,PC-DAPS利用颗粒来完善DAPS作出的其他设计决定,例如用适应性高斯混合物模型(GMM)的近似值取代去诺氏近似值。 说明这种高斯混合物近似作用的玩具例子见A.3节。

blocks.en:
What remains is to describe how PC-DAPS (i) identifies when particles commit prematurely, (ii) identifies which particles are problematic, (iii) corrects the identified particles, and (iv) constructs the multimodal denoising distribution approximation from the bag.
PC-DAPS makes two core changes to DAPS, utilizing K K particles annealed in parallel: a pruning technique to correct particles trapped in prior-inconsistent likelihood modes in tasks with likelihood ambiguity ( Section 4.1 ), and a multimodal denoising distribution approximation estimated from the diversity of the particles ( Section 4.2 ). Additional implementation details and ablations are provided in Section A.4 , such as omitting the final Langevin refinement and adaptive ODE stepping from high to low noise to improve reconstruction quality while reducing computational cost ( Section A.5 ). The full algorithm ( Algorithm 1 ) can be found in Section A.1 .

Table 1 shows that while PC-DAPS is not uniformly superior to all baselines, it performs competitively across all experiments and often achieves the highest sample quality, with the most substantial improvements in phase retrieval. In particular, the phase-retrieval results for PC-DAPS are competitive across metrics despite its handicap in evaluation protocol; for PC-DAPS we average metrics across the four samples it generates in a single run, whereas all baselines are evaluated on only the best sample (chosen using ground-truth knowledge) generated across four independent runs.
Moreover, despite it’s prune-and-replace strategy, we observe that the samples generated within a single PC-DAPS bag typically still contain a similar level of diversity as samples generated by independent DAPS runs, as shown in Figure 3 and Section A.7 .

blocks.en: Table 1 reports standard metrics to facilitate baseline comparisons. However, the evaluation procedure masks the failure mode PC-DAPS aims to address (measurement-consistent reconstructions that the prior does not support), because the best-of- k k evaluation protocol used by baseline methods discards k − 1 k-1 of the reconstructed images. On phase retrieval, we instead classify every sample as faithful , upside-down / color-inverted (a measurement-consistent likelihood mode the natural-image prior would down-weight), or failed . Labels are assigned automatically using per-channel PSNR to the ground truth and its rotated version, maximizing over ± 1 \pm 1 -pixel circular shifts to account for translation ambiguity. A channel is assigned to an orientation only when it is more than 1 1 dB closer to that orientation; samples with all channels matching the ground truth are faithful , those matching the rotation or disagreeing across channels are upside-down / color-inverted , and the remainder are failed . blocks.en: On FFHQ, PC-DAPS lowers the rate of upside-down or color-inverted reconstructions from 14.5 % 14.5\% to 1.5 % 1.5\% and raises the rate of faithful reconstructions from 79.5 % 79.5\% to 97.5 % 97.5\% . This addresses the main failure mode PC-DAPS is meant to fix. On ImageNet, the improvements are smaller: the proportion of faithful reconstructions increases from 38.5 % 38.5\% to 45.0 % 45.0\% , while the proportion of unrecoverable runs/bags (runs/bags where there exists no faithful sample) drops from 25 % 25\% to 15 % 15\% , and the rate of upside-down or color-inverted reconstructions decreases from 42.0 % 42.0\% to 30.5 % 30.5\% . PC-DAPS relies on prior consistency to disambiguate the color and orientation ambiguities in phase-retrieval measurements, but the multi-class ImageNet prior provides weaker disambiguating signals at varying noise scales when compared to the FFHQ prior. When the local geometry of the prior support is more complex, data-manifold-based prior-consistency pruning appears to be less effective.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Results in the diffusion literature for ambiguous inverse problems are usually reported as best-of- k k , with selection using the ground truth. This evaluation approach became common because existing solvers are inconsistent across runs, and a single-sample result would have large variations in quality. We see this instability as a symptom of premature mode selection in the context of measurement ambiguity. We introduce PC-DAPS to utilize the learned prior information to reduce this unwanted variance during sampling without the need for a ground-truth reference. Even in high-dimensional datasets, including FFHQ, our method demonstrates significant improvements due to the local structure of the prior. PC-DAPS obtains a smaller improvement on more structurally diverse datasets, namely ImageNet, because the prior landscape is more complex, exposing a remaining limitation and open problem to be addressed. We encourage future work to further explore our proposed paradigm of leveraging the prior score to assess candidate reconstructions at inference time, and work towards eliminating prior-inconsistent reconstructions even under less-structured priors.
blocks.zh: 传播文献中对于模棱两可的反向问题的结果,通常报告为最好kkk,选择时使用地面真理. 这种评价方法变得很普遍,因为现有的解决者相互矛盾,单一抽样结果在质量上会有较大差异。 我们认为,这种不稳定是计量模糊性背景下过早选择模式的症状。 我们采用PC-DAPS,以利用以往获得的信息,在取样时减少这种不必要的差异,而不需要地面实况参考。 即使在包括FFHQ在内的高维度数据集中,我们的方法也显示出由于先前的局部结构而有很大的改进. PC-DAPS在结构更多样化的数据集即ImageNet上得到了较小的改进,因为之前的地貌更为复杂,暴露了有待解决的剩余限制和开放问题. 我们鼓励今后进一步探讨我们提议的利用先前得分来在推断时间评估候选重建的模式,并努力消除事先不一致的重建,即使是在结构较差的前身下。

blocks.en: Standard metrics like PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS measure how similar a generated image is to a single reference image. Observe that these evaluation metrics penalize methods that find several plausible solutions that are equally valid under the measurement and prior if the solutions are dissimilar from the fixed reference. Because sample diversity and likelihood consistency are explicit goals of posterior sampling, including in applications such as uncertainty quantification, these sample-quality metrics are not adequate replacements for quality of the sampled posterior. In our work, we report a separate axis of reconstruction quality: prior consistency. We believe this or similar multifaceted metrics should be considered alongside standard fidelity metrics.
blocks.zh: PSNR,SSIM,LPIPS等标准度量衡,测量生成的图像与单一参考图像的相似程度. 指出这些评价衡量标准将惩罚那些在衡量中找到几种同样有效的合理解决办法的方法,如果这些解决办法与固定参照方法不同的话。 由于样本的多样性和可能性一致性是后采样的明确目标,包括在不确定性量化等应用中,这些样本质量的衡量标准不足以取代样本后采样的质量. 在我们的工作中,我们报告重建质量的一个单独轴心:以前的一致性。 我们认为,这种或类似的多方面衡量标准应当与标准忠诚度衡量标准一并考虑。

blocks.en: A.4 Additional implementation choices
blocks.zh: A.4 其他实施选择

blocks.en: There are two implementation choices that are orthogonal to the core PC-DAPS algorithm but improve reconstruction quality or computational efficiency in practice: skipping the final Langevin refinement and using adaptive ODE stepping. Their effects are summarized in Table 3 and described in detail below.
blocks.zh: 有两个执行选择,对核心PC-DAPS算法是正交的,但在实践中提高了重建质量或计算效率:跳过最终的Langevin改进,使用适应性的ODE脚步. 其影响摘要见表3,详细介绍如下。

blocks.en: At the final annealing time ( t 0 = 0 t_{0}=0 ), the Langevin update is not performed, and the ODE endpoint x ^ 0 ​ ( x t 0 ) \hat{x}_{0}(x_{t_{0}}) is used as the output. When the noise is nearly zero, the Langevin step size becomes very small, and the added noise can slightly reduce sample quality.

To compute the DAPS clean estimate x ^ 0 ​ ( x t i ) \hat{x}_{0}(x_{t_{i}}) , the probability flow ODE is integrated using Euler steps. One Euler step is used at high noise levels, where the clean estimate is less sensitive to the precise ODE integration, and this is increased to five steps at lower noise levels, where the prior becomes more discriminative and finer integration reduces discretization error near the data manifold. Since PC-DAPS utilizes a bag of multiple particles, reducing unnecessary ODE evaluations is important for controlling the additional computational cost. Adaptive ODE stepping is therefore used to improve the time efficiency of the particle-based sampler.
blocks.zh: 要计算 DAPS 的 clean 估计 x ^ 0 (x t i )\hat{x}_{0} (x_{t_{i}}) , 概率流量 ODE 使用 Euler 步骤整合 。 一个欧勒步骤用于高噪声水平,在高噪声水平下,清洁估计对精确的ODE集成不太敏感,在低噪声水平下,这个步骤增加到5个步骤,其中前一个步骤变得更加有区别性,更细的集成会减少数据复数附近的光碟化错误. 由于PC-DAPS使用一包多个粒子,减少不必要的ODE评价对于控制额外的计算成本十分重要. 因此,采用了可适应的ODE脚步法,以提高颗粒取样器的时间效率。

blocks.en: A.5 Time cost
blocks.zh: A.5 时间成本

blocks.en: PC-DAPS keeps K K particles in one sampling trajectory, while DAPS needs K K separate runs to get K K candidate reconstructions. If implementation overhead is ignored, both methods need about the same number of denoiser evaluations, which increases roughly linearly with K K . PC-DAPS does have extra steps, including clustering, estimating mixture parameters, and a one-shot pruning step. However, these add only a small overhead compared to the cost of the ODE and Langevin updates.
blocks.zh: PC-DAPS将K K粒子保存在一个采样轨迹中,而DAPS需要K K单独运行才能获得K K候选重建. 如果忽略了执行间接费用,这两种方法都需要大约相同数量的 " denoiser " 评价,而 " KK " 的评价大致呈线性增长。 PC-DAPS确实有额外的步骤,包括组合,估计混合物参数,以及一个一弹一弹的冲刺步骤. 然而,与ODE和Langevin的更新费用相比,这些只增加了少量的间接费用.

blocks.en: The implementation choices in Section A.4 , such as skipping the final Langevin refinement and using adaptive ODE steps at low noise, help lower the sampling cost of PC-DAPS. Figure 8 shows the measured wall-clock time and reconstruction quality. For super-resolution, PC-DAPS takes longer than DAPS because it uses multiple particles. For phase retrieval, though, the DAPS runtime includes four separate runs because it uses a best-of-4 evaluation protocol. PC-DAPS, on the other hand, creates the particle set in one run and selects internally. These results suggest that using multiple particles does not always mean a much higher wall-clock cost to achieve the same quality metric.
blocks.zh: A.4节中的执行选择,例如跳过最终的Langevin改进,在低噪音下使用适应性的ODE步骤,有助于降低PC-DAPS的采样成本. 图8显示测量的墙时钟时间和重建质量。 对于超分辨率,PC-DAPS比DAPS需要更长的时间,因为它使用多个粒子. 然而,对于阶段检索,DAPS运行时间包括四个独立的运行,因为它使用最佳的4级评价协议. 另一方面,PC-DAPS在一个运行中创建粒子集,并在内部选择. 这些结果表明,使用多颗粒子并不一定意味着实现同样质量的衡量标准所需的墙时成本要高得多。

blocks.en: A.6 Inverse problem setup
blocks.zh: A.6 反向问题设置

blocks.en: In Table 1 , following the inverse-problem settings of DAPS ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , the benchmark includes the eight tasks from DAPS: 4 × 4{\times} super-resolution, box inpainting, random inpainting, Gaussian deblurring, motion deblurring, nonlinear deblurring, phase retrieval, and high dynamic range (HDR) reconstruction. For these tasks, the same measurement operators, measurement noise level, and evaluation protocol as DAPS are used. Unless otherwise stated, measurements are corrupted with additive Gaussian noise with standard deviation β y = 0.05 \beta_{y}=0.05 . Methods are evaluated on 100 test images from each dataset, FFHQ and ImageNet, at a resolution of 256 × 256 256{\times}256 . Additionally, 16 × 16{\times} super-resolution and high-pass filtering from Thaker et al. (2025) are included in the table and described in detail below.
blocks.zh: 在表1中,按照DAPS的反向问题设置(张等人,2025年),基准包括DAPS的8项任务:4×4×时}超解,盒涂,随机涂,高斯脱溴,运动脱溴,无线脱溴,相位检索,高动态范围重建. 对于这些任务,使用与DAPS相同的测量操作器,测量噪声水平,以及评价协议. 除非另有说明,高斯噪音添加剂会破坏测量,其标准偏差为β y = 0.05\β y 0.05。 对每个数据集(FFHQ和ImageNet)的100个测试图像进行方法评价,分辨率为256×256 256}256。 此外,从Thaker等人(2025年)获得的16×16{\Times]超解析度和高通滤波法也列在表中,详细介绍如下.

blocks.en: Bicubic downsampling is applied from 256 × 256 256{\times}256 to 16 × 16 16{\times}16 , followed by additive Gaussian noise with standard deviation β y = 0.05 \beta_{y}=0.05 . This uses the same linear bicubic downsampling operator as the 4 × 4{\times} super-resolution task in DAPS, but with a larger downsampling factor. The resulting operator has a larger null space, leaving more image content unconstrained by the measurement and providing a more challenging setting. All other sampler settings follow the 4 × 4{\times} super-resolution configuration.

Following Thaker et al. (2025) , a 61 × 61 61{\times}61 convolutional kernel is used, constructed as a Dirac delta minus a Gaussian blur kernel with standard deviation 5.0 5.0 . The resulting kernel has zero sum and therefore removes the DC component. Gaussian noise with standard deviation β y = 0.05 \beta_{y}=0.05 is added to the filtered image.
blocks.zh: 接下来 Thaker等人(2025年),使用61×61 61\times}61 转式内核,构造为Dirac delta减去高斯模糊内核,标准偏差为5.0 5.0. 由此产生的内核有零和,因此去除DC组件. 带有标准偏差β y = 0.05\β_{y}=0.05的高斯噪声被添加到过滤图像中.

blocks.en: A.6.1 Baseline details
blocks.zh: A.6.1 基线细节

blocks.en: For DAPS ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , DPS ( Chung et al., 2023 ) , DDNM ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , FPS-SMC ( Dou and Song, 2024 ) , RED-Diff ( Mardani et al., 2024 ) , FGPS ( Thaker et al., 2025 ) , PnP-DM ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , and DPnP ( Xu and Chi, 2024 ) , the authors’ official public implementations and recommended task-specific hyperparameters are used throughout the benchmark. DAPS uses the DAPS-4K configuration for nonlinear tasks and DAPS-1K for linear tasks. For consistency in computational budget, PC-DAPS uses the DAPS-1K configuration for both linear and nonlinear tasks, including its adaptive variant across all tasks. When a baseline specifies task-specific step sizes or noise-schedule parameters, the reported values are used without modification. HIO, a classical phase retrieval method, is included as an additional reference baseline, with results taken from Zhang et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: DAPS(张等人,2025年),DPS (Chung等人,2023年),DDNM(Wang等人,2023年),FPS-SMC(Dou and Song,2024年),RED-Diff(Mardani等人,2024年),FGPS(Thaker等人,2025年),PnP-DM(Wu等人,2024年),和DPnP(徐和戚,2024年),作者的官方公开执行和推荐的任务特定超参数在整个基准使用. DAPS将DAPS-4K配置用于非线性任务,DAPS-1K用于线性任务. 为了计算预算的一致性,PC-DAPS将DAPS-1K配置用于线性任务和非线性任务,包括其适用于所有任务的适应变体. 当基准指定了特定任务步骤大小或噪音时间表参数时,不加修改地使用所报告的数值。 HIO是一种古典的相位检索方法,作为额外的参考基准列入其中,结果取自张等人(2025年).

blocks.en: For the two additional tasks not included in the DAPS benchmark, 16 × 16{\times} super-resolution and high-pass filtering, the closest corresponding configuration available for each baseline is used: the 4 × 4{\times} super-resolution configuration for 16 × 16{\times} super-resolution and the Gaussian deblurring configuration for high-pass filtering. Only the measurement operator and the associated measurement generation are modified to match the task definitions described above.
blocks.zh: 对于DAPS基准中未包含的另外两项任务,16×16{\Times}超解析度和高通滤波器,使用每个基线可用的最接近的对应配置: 4×4{\Times}超解析配置 16×16{\Times}超解析度和高斯解析配置用于高通滤波器. 只有测量操作员和相关测量生成才经过修改,以与上述任务定义相匹配.

blocks.en: Unless otherwise specified, PC-DAPS uses the 1 1 K setting with 200 annealing steps and adaptive ODE stepping, and generates K = 4 K=4 reconstructions for each measurement. Reported PC-DAPS metrics are averaged over the four reconstructions. For phase retrieval, baselines other than PC-DAPS are evaluated using the best of four independent runs, selecting the reconstruction closest to the ground-truth image, following prior work ( Chung et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . This protocol gives the baselines access to ground-truth information that is unavailable to PC-DAPS at test time. PSNR, SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) are reported in Table 1 for all methods. For ablation studies, the PC-DAPS variants follow the corresponding DAPS settings reported in Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,PC-DAPS使用带有200个仰角步骤和适应性ODE阶梯的11K设置,并生成K=4K=4的重建,用于每次测量. 所报告的PC-DAPS衡量标准平均为四个重建项目。 为了进行阶段检索,使用四个独立运行中最好的一个来评估PC-DAPS以外的基线,选择最接近地面真实图像的重建,然后进行前期工作(Chung等人,2023年;Zhang等人,2025年)。 该协议为测试时PC-DAPS无法获取的地面真实信息提供了基线访问权. PSNR, SSIM(Wang等人,2004年)和LPIPS(Zhang等人,2018年)在所有方法中均在表1中报告. 对于消化研究,PC-DAPS的变体遵循表5中所报告的相应的DAPS设置.
